description: Source code for handling 'Set' requests in a USP (Universal Service Platform) agent, including functions for expanding path expressions, processing partial and non-partial set requests, and constructing response messages with success or failure details.

classes.name: set_expr_info_t
classes.description: Structure representing a set expression, including path, resolved objects, parameters, and error info.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_HandleSet
methods.description: Main handler for incoming USP Set messages, delegates to Grouped_HandleSet.

methods.name: Grouped_HandleSet
methods.description: Processes a USP Set message, expanding path expressions, and handling partial/non-partial set logic.

methods.name: ExpandSetPathExpression
methods.description: Expands a path expression into resolved objects and group set vector entries.

methods.name: ProcessSet_AllowPartialFalse
methods.description: Processes a set request with allow_partial=false, aborting on first failure.

methods.name: CreateErrRespFromFailedSetParams
methods.description: Creates an error response listing all failed required parameters.

methods.name: ProcessSet_AllowPartialTrue
methods.description: Processes a set request with allow_partial=true, allowing partial success.

methods.name: ProcessSet_AllowPartialTrue_Expression
methods.description: Processes a single expression in a partial set, with transaction handling.

methods.name: PopulateSetResp_OperSuccess
methods.description: Populates response with success info for a set expression.

methods.name: PopulateSetResp_OperFailure
methods.description: Populates response with failure info for a set expression.

methods.name: PopulateOperFailure_UpdatedInstFailure
methods.description: Adds details of failed parameters for an object in failure response.

methods.name: DestroySetExprInfo
methods.description: Frees memory associated with set expression info array.

methods.name: CreateSetResp
methods.description: Creates a new empty set response message.

methods.name: AddSetResp_OperFailure
methods.description: Adds an operation failure entry to the response.

methods.name: AddOperFailure_UpdatedInstFailure
methods.description: Adds an updated instance failure entry to an operation failure.

methods.name: AddUpdatedInstFailure_ParamErr
methods.description: Adds a parameter error to an updated instance failure.

methods.name: AddSetResp_OperSuccess
methods.description: Adds an operation success entry to the response.

methods.name: AddOperSuccess_UpdatedInstRes
methods.description: Adds an updated instance result to an operation success.

methods.name: AddUpdatedInstRes_ParamsEntry
methods.description: Adds a parameter key-value pair to an updated instance result.

methods.name: AddUpdatedInstRes_ParamErr
methods.description: Adds a parameter error to an updated instance result.
